entries.title: Matthew 28:1
segments: After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary of Magdala and the other Mary had gone to look at the grave,

entries.title: Matthew 28:2
segments: When suddenly a great earthquake occurred. For an angel of the Lord descended from Heaven, and came and rolled away the stone, and seated himself upon it.

entries.title: Matthew 28:3
segments: His appearance was as dazzling as lightning, and his clothing was as white as snow;

entries.title: Matthew 28:4
segments: And, in their terror of him, the men on guard trembled violently and became like dead men.

entries.title: Matthew 28:5
segments: But the angel, addressing the women, said; "You need not be afraid. I now that it is Jesus, who was crucified, for whom you are looking.

entries.title: Matthew 28:6
segments: He is not here; for he has risen, as he said he would. Come, and see the place where he was lying;

entries.title: Matthew 28:7
segments: And then go quickly and say to him disciples 'He has risen from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Remember, I have told you."

entries.title: Matthew 28:8
segments: On this they left the tomb quickly, in awe and great joy, and ran to tell the news to the disciples.

entries.title: Matthew 28:9
segments: Suddenly Jesus me them. "Welcome! he said. The women went up to him, and clasped his feet, bowing to the ground before him. Then Jesus said to them:

entries.title: Matthew 28:10
segments: "Do not be afraid; go and tell my brothers to set out for Galilee, and they shall see me there."

entries.title: Matthew 28:11
segments: While they were still on their way, some of the guard came into the city, and reported to the Chief Priests everything that had happened.

entries.title: Matthew 28:12
segments: So they and the Councillors met and, after holding a consultation, gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

entries.title: Matthew 28:13
segments: And told them to say that his disciples came in the night, and stole him while they were asleep;

entries.title: Matthew 28:14
segments: "And should this matter come before the Governor," they added, "we will satisfy him, and see that you have nothing to fear."

entries.title: Matthew 28:15
segments: So the soldiers took the money, and did as they were instructed. And this story has been current among the Jews from that day to this.

entries.title: Matthew 28:16
segments: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus told them to meet him;

entries.title: Matthew 28:17
segments: And, when they saw him, they bowed to the ground before him; although some felt doubtful.

entries.title: Matthew 28:18
segments: Then Jesus came up, and spoke to them thus: "All authority in heaven and on the earth has been given to me.

entries.title: Matthew 28:19
segments: Therefore go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the Faith of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Matthew 28:20
segments: And teaching them to lay to heart all the commands that I have given you; and, remember, I myself am with you every day until the close of the age."
